product_results.description: When the school supply list calls for colored pens, BIC Gelocity Quick Dry Assorted Colors Gel Pens give students and teachers a reliable option built for the demands of the school year. Twelve different colors let students color-code class notes by subject, mark up reading assignments, annotate study guides, and keep their work organized from the first day of school through finals. Teachers reach for these pens for grading, marking handouts, and keeping color-coded records without smearing across the page. Quick-dry ink dries in as little as five seconds, making these a dependable choice for left-handed students and anyone who needs work to stay clean and readable. Easy-flowing gel ink writes smoothly and consistently across lined paper, notebooks, and index cards. A full-length grip keeps writing comfortable during long sessions, from taking notes in class to finishing homework at the kitchen table. The retractable design means one click to start, with a plastic clip that keeps pens attached to notebooks throughout the school day. A reliable choice for any school supply list or classroom supply drawer.
